> [!CAUTION]
> **DO NOT post prompt injection bypasses, secret detector omissions, or sensitive vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.**

## How to Report Security Vulnerabilities Privately

To protect our users and practice responsible disclosure, please report suspected security issues privately:

1. **GitHub Private Security Advisory (Recommended)**:
   Navigate to the repository's **Security** tab -> **Advisories** -> **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Livesh-L-28/LLMFirewall/security/advisories/new)**.
2. **Security Email**:
   Send an email to `security@llmfirewall.org`.

## What to Include
- Detailed description of the potential attack vector or vulnerability.
- Minimal reproducible proof-of-concept using **synthetic test data** only.
- Affected LLMFirewall version(s).
- Any suggested remediations or mitigations.

See our complete [Security Policy](https://github.com/Livesh-L-28/LLMFirewall/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for disclosure timelines and response commitments.
